thread:
Irene: Quick review of the desktop dark console build. Two issues: inline code and code-block syntax look washed on the near-black background, and stacked-area chart colors are colliding with the alert red when overlays occur. Frames in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/dark-console-v4 (frames 'Code - Dark', 'Metrics - Stacked').

Liam: Can you paste a screenshot and which OS/browser? I saw the same issue on macOS Chrome.

Irene: macOS Chrome. Current code tokens pasted below:

```css
--bg: #07101a;
--panel: #0c1622;
--code-bg: #071420;
--syntax-keyword: #9fb7ff; /* pale blue */
--syntax-fn: #b4f6c1; /* mint */
--syntax-string: #ffd5a1; /* warm */
--code-line-number: #2a3846;
```

Diego: The keyword blue desaturates on dark surfaces. Shift to a slightly more cyan hue like '#7ec7ff' to restore legibility without being neon. Function color to '#9ef0b7' is a good bump.

Priya: Strings at small sizes are borderline. Try '#ffcf78' for better contrast. Also run inline-code against surrounding panel to ensure 4.5:1.

ThemeBot: Accessibility scan -> syntax-keyword #9fb7ff on code-bg #071420 = 3.6:1 (FAIL). syntax-string #ffd5a1 on code-bg = 3.3:1 (FAIL). Suggested fixes: keyword -> #7ec7ff, string -> #ffcf78.

Liam: For stacked-area, current palette is ['#3fb1ff','#6be08b','#ffd27a','#ff9180'] and alert red is '#ff5c4d'. The fourth series and alert are too close when overlaid. Options: change series 4 to purple '#caa0ff' or darken alert to '#e64b3e'.

Diego: Legend pill selected state blends into panel. Add a 1px inset border or a subtle selected-bg '#122632' so selected state reads. Example: 'box-shadow: 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.04) inset'.

Priya: Tiny copy tweak for toggle. Replace 'Dark theme' with 'Enable dark theme' and aria-label='Enable dark theme, toggles between light and dark' for clarity in translations. Also persist pref in localStorage + account prefs.

Irene: Focus ring for keyboard users: when focused the toggle loses contrast. Suggest '--focus-ring: rgba(120,200,255,0.2)' and a 2px solid fallback for UA that doesn't render box-shadow.

ThemeBot: Contrast checks for suggested chart swatches on panel #0c1622: '#3fb1ff' = 4.7:1, '#6be08b' = 4.5:1, '#ffd27a' = 3.8:1 (borderline), '#caa0ff' = 4.2:1. If keeping '#ffd27a', use thicker stroke or larger area. Also flag: stacked overlap creates mid-tones that can drop contrast, consider semi-transparent overlays with blend mode 'lighter' to preserve edges.

Liam: Implementation plan: expose CSS tokens and a chartPalette array. Recharts accepts hex + opacity, so we'll map with opacity for overlays. We'll add legend border and aria descriptions.

Diego: Propose an opt-in colorblind-safe palette (viridis-like) for metrics-heavy dashboards: ['#440154','#3b528b','#21918c','#5ec962','#fde725'] behind a feature flag. Priya: that works but clamp the last yellow to avoid glare on dark.

Irene: Action items: @Liam - PR with token updates, legend pill focus; @Diego - add viridis variant behind flag; @Priya - update Figma + i18n copy. I'll validate in staging once PR lands.

Liam: Draft PR incoming today.

Priya: Figma updated and comments added.

ThemeBot: Re-scan requested when PR is merged.

Irene: Thanks team 31f this should feel much clearer on first pass.
